Assume a horizontal pipe with diameter 0.1 m and length 5 m.
Assume a fixed mixture velocity of 1 m/s.
Assume water density 1000 kg/m3 and dynamic viscosity 0.001 Pa.s.
Assume oil density 800 kg/m3 and dynamic viscosity 0.005 Pa.s.
Use twoPhaseEulerFoam for the oil-water flow simulation.
Set the inlet alpha.water to fixedValue uniform 0.3.
Set the inlet phase velocities to fixedValue uniform 1 m/s in the axial direction.
Set the outlet alpha.water to zeroGradient, not fixedValue.
Set the outlet phase velocities to zeroGradient.
Set the outlet p_rgh to fixedValue 0.
Set the inlet p_rgh to zeroGradient.
Apply noSlip to both phase velocities on the pipe walls.
Set the internal field for alpha.water to 0.3.
Set the internal field for the phase velocities to 1 m/s in the axial direction.
Set the internal field for p_rgh to 0.
Run twoPhaseEulerFoam in transient mode until the flow reaches steady state.
